saw_lines: Freelancers pick an invoicing tool once and keep it for years, rarely switching after the first invoices.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening line, before a freelancer ever reaches the pricing page.
Your 11 of 22 copy ads open on one line, “meidän toimari veti homman ihan”, so write three new openers around price and freelancer payouts and run them against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Nov 2026
points: 11 of your 22 copy ads open on the same line, “meidän toimari veti homman ihan”, so anyone who scrolls past it never sees the rest. Write three new openers around price and freelancer payouts, and run them against it.
One exact copy runs in 11 of your 22 ads, so buyers who already saw it get the same words again and the ad stops feeling new. Keep the body but give each of 11 a new opening line and creative.

The fee waiver sits after body text, so a skimming buyer sees no reason to act today. Test a bundle opener in three new ads, such as the app with a first invoice, and keep the waiver as proof lower down.

7 ads have run 60 days or more, yet none of your 20 newer ads reuses the opening line of your oldest winner. Build the next three ads as variations of that winner, keeping its structure and swapping the product detail.
